project: SP-007 / DOC-2-033: Causal Graphs From Perturbation Shadows
round: R2 - same-lab cross-cell-line transport (K562 -> RPE1); supporting cross-context replication, NEVER independent replication

frozen_algorithm_from_r1.estimator: pooled-count rate vs batch-matched NTC control rate; per-batch control rates weighted by the unit's per-batch cell counts; log2((r_unit*1e6+1)/(r_ctl*1e6+1))
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.pool_size_rule: NTC pseudo-intervention pools: disjoint control-cell pools of size = median QC-pass cells per primary target IN THE DATASET BEING SCORED; n_pools = 80; seed 20260922+4
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.tau_formula: tau = median(|pseudo-pool scores|) + 2*MAD, computed per dataset before any evaluation
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.support_rule: edge supported iff |score| > tau_dataset AND 95% construct-CI excludes 0 AND per-gene NTC-null |z| >= 1.96 (z from the dataset's own matched pools)
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.construct_rule: construct = distinct guide_id VALUE (paired-guide construct); halves never independent; >=2 distinct constructs AND >=30 QC-pass cells for strict cohort
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.qc_rule: ngenes>=500, ncounts>=1000, percent_mito<=20, targeting cells nperts==1, controls perturbation=='control' AND nperts==0, '+'-named excluded (vacuity documented)
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.card_schema: unchanged from R1 (target, gene, class, score, construct_se, null_z, assoc_r, flags)
frozen_algorithm_from_r1.note: orchestrator: R1's pool-size matching was informed by a failed control, so R1's 26,525 edges are exploratory review cards; in R2 this entire algorithm is preregistered before RPE1 scoring

cohorts.rpe1_strict: >=30 QC-pass cells AND >=2 distinct construct-level guide_ids (same rule as R1)
cohorts.rpe1_descriptive: >=30 QC-pass cells; single-construct targets flagged GUIDE-REPLICATION-UNVERIFIED

transport_unit: shared target x shared measured gene; shared = target in BOTH strict cohorts AND gene measured in BOTH matrices; ID mapping (gene_name exact match on scPerturb-harmonized var) and the overlap list FROZEN before any outcome comparison

metrics.sign_agreement: fraction of shared units with concordant score sign, vs expression-matched null units
metrics.rank_correlation: Spearman correlation of per-target score vectors across shared genes, target-level
metrics.supported_set_overlap: precision/recall/Jaccard of RPE1-supported vs K562-supported edge sets per shared target
metrics.calibration: K562-supported edges: fraction RPE1-supported, vs target-permuted null rate
metrics.uncertainty: target-level bootstrap 95% CIs (1,000 resamples, seed 20260922) for every transport metric
nulls: expression-matched null genes (control-mean matched, same rule as R1)
target-permuted (score vectors permuted across shared targets)

response_gene_strata: A: constitutively expressed in BOTH lines' controls (control CPM >= 1 in K562 AND RPE1)
stratification_frozen_before_scores.purpose: separate biological cell-line context change from technical instability; no other stratification without a new lock

abstentions: cell-state claims stay abstained (no adequately supported state design preregistered)
no graph claim unless a separately locked reference-coverability floor passes in RPE1 (not attempted here)

outcomes.transport_fail: close the scoring procedure; R1 retained as K562-only atlas
outcomes.transport_pass: graduate only a cross-cell-line response-evidence procedure; NOT causal graph recovery

pass_rule_frozen: transport PASSES iff sign_agreement AND rank_correlation AND supported-set precision each beat their respective null 95th percentile with bootstrap CI excluding the null rate; else transport_fail
